## Problem and evidence

Link the task and explain the failing state transition.

## Proposed change

Name the target upstream revision. Describe resulting behavior and any assumptions about the customized installation.

## Validation

State what was actually tested, the observed result and what remains unverified. For exception recovery, include a mocked provider failure after a completed harmless tool call.

## Public material review

Confirm that the diff contains only the evidence or code needed for this investigation.
